data.title: A smaller promise

memoryNodes.cue: The first ambition is larger than the available funding.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 最初设想超出现有资金。

memoryNodes.cue: They make a smaller, carefully limited claim.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 她们提出范围较小、谨慎限定的主张。

memoryNodes.cue: They will revisit the room at a later stage.
memoryNodes.cueZh: 她们会在后续阶段再次查看房间。

data.situation:
At the last stage of the project, Maya opened the original plan. They had hoped to rebuild the room; the funding would not cover it. As a consequence, they proposed moving a few chairs and adjusting the lamp. They would check whether these changes were effective over a longer period. Jo wanted their report to meet a clear standard of accuracy, even if it could not offer a dramatic conclusion. To the centre committee
We recommend a small change first. Our observations are limited to two afternoons. Similarly, the questionnaire tells us only what these visitors chose to say. We would like to form a small group for a longer investigation. We will return to the room next month and report what we find.

readingBlocks.en: At the last stage of the project, Maya opened the original plan. They had hoped to rebuild the room; the funding would not cover it. As a consequence, they proposed moving a few chairs and adjusting the lamp. They would check whether these changes were effective over a longer period. Jo wanted their report to meet a clear standard of accuracy, even if it could not offer a dramatic conclusion.
readingBlocks.zh: 项目最后阶段，玛雅打开最初的方案。她们原想重建房间，资金却不够。因此，她们提议移动几把椅子、调整台灯。她们会在更长时间内查看这些改动是否有效。乔希望报告达到明确的准确性标准，哪怕无法给出惊人的结论。

readingBlocks.en:
To the centre committee
We recommend a small change first. Our observations are limited to two afternoons. Similarly, the questionnaire tells us only what these visitors chose to say. We would like to form a small group for a longer investigation. We will return to the room next month and report what we find.
readingBlocks.zh:
致中心委员会
建议先作小改动。我们的观察只限于两个下午。同样，问卷只能告诉我们这些访客选择表达的内容。我们希望组建一个小组，开展更长期调查。下个月我们将回到房间，再报告发现。

glossary.example: They reached the final stage of the project.
glossary.exampleZh: 她们到达项目最后阶段。

externalEvidence.definition: any distinct time period in a sequence of events

glossary.zh: 从一开始就存在的；最初的
glossary.note: 本例时间上的最初，不是新颖或真迹。
glossary.example: Maya compared the report with the original plan.
glossary.exampleZh: 玛雅对比报告和最初方案。

externalEvidence.definition: preceding all others in time or being as first made or performed

glossary.zh: 由某行为或条件引起的结果
glossary.note: a consequence of / as a consequence；不必是负面。
glossary.example: As a consequence of limited funding, they proposed a smaller change.
glossary.exampleZh: 由于资金有限，她们提议较小的改动。

externalEvidence.definition: a phenomenon that follows and is caused by some previous phenomenon

glossary.zh: 产生预期效果的；有效的
glossary.note: effective in/at；这里尚待检查，不把项目写作当实证。
glossary.example: They will check whether the changes are effective.
glossary.exampleZh: 她们会查看改动是否有效。

externalEvidence.definition: producing or capable of producing an intended result or having a striking effect-LewisMumford

glossary.zh: 质量或表现应达到的水平；标准
glossary.note: 可数名词，meet a standard；与常规型号形容词区分。
glossary.example: The report should meet a clear standard of accuracy.
glossary.exampleZh: 报告应达到明确的准确性标准。

externalEvidence.label: Oxford Learner’s Dictionaries
externalEvidence.reviewFinding: Level of quality, contrasted with standard ordinary-features adjective.

glossary.note: 连接存在相似限制的两点，不应随意串联不相似观点。
glossary.example: Similarly, the questionnaire covers only these visitors.
glossary.exampleZh: 同样，问卷只涉及这些访客。

externalEvidence.definition: in like or similar manner- Samuel Johnson

glossary.note: 动词 form a group/team；不是名词表格。
glossary.example: They formed a small group to continue the investigation.
glossary.exampleZh: 她们组建一个小组，继续调查。

retrievalPrompts.cue: Compare the first plan with the current stage.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 比较原方案和当前阶段。
acceptableAnswers: At this stage, they propose a smaller change than the original plan.
checks: 按情境表达，允许其他自然说法

retrievalPrompts.cue: Explain the result of limited money and what remains to be checked.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 解释资金限制的结果，以及什么仍待检查。
acceptableAnswers: As a consequence of limited funding, they need to check whether a small change is effective.
checks: 按情境表达，允许其他自然说法

retrievalPrompts.cue: Explain the report’s accuracy, the limits of the two sources and the plan for further work.
retrievalPrompts.cueZh: 说明报告准确性、两种资料的局限，以及后续计划。
acceptableAnswers: The report should meet a standard of accuracy. The observations cover two afternoons; similarly, the questionnaire covers only these visitors. They will form a small group for further work.
checks: 按情境表达，允许其他自然说法

transferPrompt.cue: Your group cannot afford its original plan. Explain a smaller proposal.
transferPrompt.cueZh: 小组负担不起原方案。解释一个更小的提议。
acceptableAnswers: As a consequence of limited funding, we propose a smaller change and will check whether it is effective.
checks: 按情境表达，允许其他自然说法
